announcements.title: VerusMiner v6 is here 🎉
announcements.description: CPU-specific v8a builds + in-app build recommendation, Mining power profiles, overnight Keep mining connected (Wi‑Fi/battery), history graphs. Releases on GitHub.
announcements.content:
VerusMiner v6 is here

Thanks for mining with us. Version 6 is a big step forward for phone mining: CPU-specific optimized builds with in-app recommendations, smarter Mining power profiles, better overnight reliability, clearer stats, and less battery drama when you set things up once.

What's new

CPU-specific optimized miner builds

v6 ships with a much wider catalog of CPU-tuned miner binaries (named v8a-<tag>). Matching the build to your cores can mean better hashrate at the same heat and power than a one-size-fits-all binary.

Official downloads live on the GitHub releases page (not the Play Store).

Supported CPU builds (binary → target CPU)

Generic

  • v8a-gen — generic — safe default when CPU is unknown

ARM Cortex-A (efficiency / mid)

  • v8a-ca34 — Cortex-A34
  • v8a-ca35 — Cortex-A35
  • v8a-ca53 — Cortex-A53
  • v8a-ca55 — Cortex-A55
  • v8a-ca57 — Cortex-A57
  • v8a-ca65 — Cortex-A65
  • v8a-ca65ae — Cortex-A65AE
  • v8a-ca510 — Cortex-A510
  • v8a-ca520 — Cortex-A520

ARM Cortex-A (performance)

  • v8a-ca72 — Cortex-A72
  • v8a-ca73 — Cortex-A73
  • v8a-ca75 — Cortex-A75
  • v8a-ca76 — Cortex-A76
  • v8a-ca76ae — Cortex-A76AE
  • v8a-ca77 — Cortex-A77
  • v8a-ca78 — Cortex-A78
  • v8a-ca78c — Cortex-A78C
  • v8a-ca78ae — Cortex-A78AE
  • v8a-ca710 — Cortex-A710
  • v8a-ca715 — Cortex-A715
  • v8a-ca720 — Cortex-A720
  • v8a-ca725 — Cortex-A725

ARM Cortex-X / R

  • v8a-cx1 — Cortex-X1
  • v8a-cx1c — Cortex-X1C
  • v8a-cx2 — Cortex-X2
  • v8a-cx3 — Cortex-X3
  • v8a-cx4 — Cortex-X4
  • v8a-cx925 — Cortex-X925
  • v8a-cr82 — Cortex-R82

ARM Neoverse

  • v8a-nve1 — Neoverse-E1
  • v8a-nvn1 — Neoverse-N1
  • v8a-nvn2 — Neoverse-N2
  • v8a-nvn3 — Neoverse-N3
  • v8a-nvv1 — Neoverse-V1
  • v8a-nvv2 — Neoverse-V2
  • v8a-nvv3 — Neoverse-V3

Qualcomm / Samsung / others

  • v8a-kryo — Qualcomm Kryo
  • v8a-exm3 — Exynos-M3
  • v8a-exm4 — Exynos-M4
  • v8a-exm5 — Exynos-M5
  • v8a-falkor — Falkor
  • v8a-saphira — Saphira
  • v8a-tsv110 — TSV110
  • v8a-thunderx — ThunderX
  • v8a-thunderx2t99 — ThunderX2 T99
  • v8a-ampere1 — Ampere1
  • v8a-ampere1a — Ampere1A
  • v8a-a64fx — A64FX
  • v8a-apa7 — Apple-A7
  • v8a-apa10 — Apple-A10
  • v8a-apa14 — Apple-A14
  • v8a-apm1 — Apple-M1

Notes: Not every tag may appear in every release folder on day one — grab the latest from GitHub. On mixed big.LITTLE phones the recommender prefers the faster cores (and will not pick Kryo over a stronger ARM big core when both are present). Unknown CPUs fall back to v8a-gen.

Build recommendation (new)

You no longer need to guess which binary fits your phone:

  • Open Device Info (stop mining first)
  • Run Detect CPU topology / review the build suggestion card
  • The app reads your CPU parts, maps them to the catalog above, and suggests the best v8a-* build — plus other on-device matches and v8a-gen as a safe try list
  • Compare fairly: run each candidate a similar duration and watch hashrate and temperature
  • After switching a build or Mining power profile, restart mining so the new binary and settings apply

Optimized mining (Mining power)

Stop guessing thread counts. Mining power profiles map to how modern phones work (big.LITTLE cores, heat, and battery):

  • Balanced — everyday mining with about half your cores; good hashrate without cooking the phone
  • Performance — prefers the faster cores when your device has them, for higher hashrate when plugged in and cooled
  • Cooler — fewer cores than Balanced so the phone stays cooler and the battery lasts longer (great overnight or in warm rooms)
  • Custom — full manual control of threads and pause limits when you want to tune further

Profiles can also apply comfort pauses: auto-pause on high temperature or low battery, then resume after a cooldown — so mining protects the hardware instead of thrashing until it throttles.

Overnight connection & network tips (Keep mining connected)

Mining that dies when the screen turns off is usually the phone sleeping Wi‑Fi or killing the app — not the pool. Use Keep mining connected in Settings before long or overnight sessions:

  • Battery unrestricted / don’t optimize VerusMiner — stop Android from killing the miner in the background
  • Wi‑Fi stays on when the screen is off (Wi‑Fi sleep policy “Never” on older phones) — or use solid mobile data if that is more reliable on your network
  • Turn off aggressive power saving modes that cut CPU or network overnight
  • Check OEM “battery savers”, auto-kill / sleep apps, and game/boost modes that break long sessions
  • Prefer a stable 2.4 GHz or wired-router Wi‑Fi near the device; avoid captive portals and flaky guest networks
  • Do not swipe VerusMiner away from Recents while mining — that kills the process
  • Use temperature and battery pause limits (or Cooler profile) so overnight heat or low charge pauses cleanly instead of hard disconnects
  • Optional: game/performance modes when supported, for steadier clocks during the session
Tip: plug in for multi-hour runs, pick Cooler or Balanced, finish Keep mining connected once per phone model, and leave space for airflow. If shares stop overnight, re-check Wi‑Fi sleep and battery unrestricted first.

History and graphs

  • Session history with ranges (1h to 30d, custom)
  • Live charts while mining: hashrate, temperature, shares, difficulty
  • When mining stops, home can still show your last session graphs so you can review what worked

Smoother mining UX

  • Clearer home and bottom navigation
  • Accepted/hour and other metrics that are easier to read
  • Notice if the app was force-closed while mining (so you know why it stopped)
  • Refreshed onboarding and Quickstart for first-time setup

Look and language

  • Multiple themes (including community styles)
  • More languages via refreshable language packs
  • Use Translate / Copy on this announcement if you need another language

Tips after updating

  • Open Device Info → detect CPU topology (stop mining first)
  • Install the suggested v8a-* build from GitHub if an upgrade is recommended
  • Try Mining power: Balanced daily, Performance when plugged in, Cooler overnight
  • Open Keep mining connected and finish battery + Wi‑Fi items for each phone
  • Refresh languages/themes if you want the latest remote packs

Download and details

Official VerusMiner app and CPU-specific miner builds are on GitHub (not the Play Store). Use the button below or open the GitHub releases page for notes and downloads.

Happy hashing — and thank you for supporting the Verus community.
